content:
sarah_partners: Datadog reached out about doing a joint observability demo at KubeCon. Ask: live demo on their booth, a dashboard tile, and a 30s clip for social. They also want a short co-marketing blurb and an embargoed press mention 5 days prior. Can we pull this off in ~2 weeks?
mike_eng: timeline tight but doable. What infra do they want us to run on?
sarah_partners: they prefer we use our staging dedicated pool so their ops can validate OTLP end-to-end.
jess_ops: staging dedicated pool is OK if we scope keys and rotate afterwards. No customer data, synthetic prompts only.
anna_pm: do we have a demo app that emits OTLP traces and GPU metrics?
mike_eng: we have inference-playground; needs a config change to send model metadata and a cache span flag. I'll add model.name and cache.hit to spans.
oliver_docs: I'll prepare the demo README and a one-file reproducible package. Mike 4: can you provide the OTLP exporter config snippet for docs?
mike_eng: snippet for docs:
```
exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: "https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317"
    headers: { "DD-API-KEY": "<REDACTED>" }
resource_attributes:
  service.name: "redwood-inference-demo"
span_attributes:
  model.name: "redwood-vicuna-7b"
  cache.hit: true/false
metrics:
  - infer.lat_ms
  - infer.tokens
  - gpu.utilization
  - cache.hit_ratio
```
sarah_partners: Datadog specifically asked for two trace captures: (1) cold-start end-to-end and (2) cached-run (KV cache hit). They want to show the waterfall difference and latency delta.
mike_eng: I'll produce both captures and attach pre-recorded trace files. I'll flip sampling to 100% in demo-only config and enable verbose span attrs.
jess_ops: note: ensure API key is scoped to a demo-only ingestion and rotated after the event. I'll handle key gating and infra network rules.
anna_pm: marketing needs a short joint quote for the announcement. I can draft and route to Matt for sign-off.
oliver_docs: question for the dashboard: should tile pull runtime aggregated metrics or raw nvidia-smi host metrics?
mike_eng: runtime-aggregated for per-request insights + nvidia exporter for host GPU telemetry. Dashboard panels: trace waterfall, latency heatmap, tokens/sec, cost-per-token gauge, and GPU util timeline.
sarah_partners: Datadog wants a 30-45s social clip that shows: trigger request -> trace waterfall -> dashboard highlights -> latency/cost stat. Can we capture a clean flow?
oliver_docs: yes I'll produce a short MP4 from a recorded dry-run. I'll also prepare a checklist for the clip (timing, captions, resolution).
mike_eng: I'll open branch `dd-kubecon-obsv-demo` and push the OTLP changes + sample trace dumps. PR will include instructions to reproduce traces locally.
jess_ops: legal pinged for co-marketing terms. Waiting for reply; will update channel when I hear back.
sarah_partners: timeline proposal: today 0: lock scope. +2d 0: infra + traces ready. +4d 0: docs, clip draft, joint quote. +6d 0: partner review & legal sign-off. +8d 0: embargo lift / demo day. Any issues?
anna_pm: owners: mike_eng 1: infra/tracing + PR; oliver_docs 2: demo artifacts + clip + slide; jess_ops 3: keys/legal liaison + infra gating; sarah_partners 4: partner coordination & booth logistics; anna_pm 5: quote draft & partner QA.
mike_eng: I'll also include span attributes for model.version and sequence_length to help illustrate perf characteristics.
sarah_partners: Datadog rep (eric_dd) also asked if we can show cache hit ratio in traces and annotate spans with model_name. Confirmed?
mike_eng: yes, we'll add cache.hit boolean and model_name attribute on relevant spans.
jess_ops: reminder: no customer prompts or PII in any demo data. Use synthetic dataset.
oliver_docs: I'll bundle a docker-compose demo and pre-captured traces so partners can replay offline.
sarah_partners: Datadog asked for a 30-minute dry-run prior to the show. Who can join?
mike_eng: I can.
anna_pm: me, sarah, oliver available too.
jess_ops: I'll be on-call for infra troubleshooting during the dry-run.
oliver_docs: I'll upload runbook and artifacts to the demo bucket and drop the link here once uploaded. Runbook will include rollback steps and network checks.
sarah_partners: marketing wants a 1-2 co-branded slides outlining integration points & the observable signals we surface. Oliver, please draft and circulate for quick review.
oliver_docs: will do.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: branch dd-kubecon-obsv-demo -> demo-staging at 2021-07-15T14:32Z :rocket:
sarah_partners: locking scope for EOD unless objections. Thanks team :party_parrot:
anna_pm: lock. :thumbsup:
